name: undeniable-truth-sac-draw-prep
notes: Undeniable Truth (UaUfw7yFTW, GameLogic.php's DoActivateCard 'Declaring Costs' section ~line 2852 / customDQHandlers["UndeniableTruthCost"], GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["UaUfw7yFTW:0"]): "As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice an ally. Draw a card, then put a preparation counter on your champion." An ally (Dungeon Guide) is seeded on the field. Playing the card from hand queues a mandatory MZCHOOSE to sacrifice an ally BEFORE the 1-reserve cost is paid; choosing the seeded ally sacrifices it (DoSacrificeFighter), then reserve is paid, then the card's own effect (Draw + AddPrepCounter) resolves. Verified live: the ally lands in the graveyard and the champion gains a preparation counter. Break/restore verified: commenting out the AddPrepCounter() call in cardActivatedAbilities["UaUfw7yFTW:0"] leaves the champion's Counters empty and the fixture fails; restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice an ally. Draw a card, then put a preparation counter on your champion.
